card.name: Adjectives and word starts in scientific prose
card.fires_on: Adjectives or partial words in academic science text that come just before a noun, such as 'mut-ational', 'powerful', 'genetic', 'Andean' and 'biochemical'. The next word is usually a noun like 'effects', 'systems' or 'mechanisms'.

modes.label: Modifier before research noun
modes.description: An adjective in a science sentence that sets up a noun such as systems or mechanisms.

modes.label: Partway through a modifier word
modes.description: The first part of a longer descriptive word, with the rest still to come.

card.writes: It suppresses 'propose' and 'proposal' forms, so it steers the model away from predicting those words next.
card.plain: It fires on descriptive words in scientific writing that lead into a noun, and it lowers the chance of 'propose' words coming next.
